description: What Route A's local base run for commit 4b57d15a2 wrote before it stopped, for comparing the Modal base with it (tools/modal_us_stage_plan.py compare-lineage; runbook, Route A's base stage, step 6). The local run (route_a.sh section 4, run directory run-4b57d15a287c, 2026-09-28) completed its first two outer stages and was then stopped by its supervisor's disk floor (base-sup.failed-1790651711/RESULT.json: refusal DISK_FLOOR, returncode -9). Its base-checkpoints/stage_run_context.json records both completed stages with these checkpoint sha256, and the files hashed to the same values on 2026-09-29. The frame checkpoint writer sets track_times=False on every HDF5 object (packages/microcosm-build/src/microcosm/build/frame_checkpoint.py at 4b57d15a2), and neither file contains the machine's paths, interpreter or platform strings, so equal inputs and equal numerics give equal bytes. source_sha256 equals microcosm.build.code_identity's digest recomputed over the committed tree of 4b57d15a2, so a clean clone of that commit gives the same value. The local run's pipeline (24 outer stages, pipeline_sha256 906c9c02...) is copied from that stage_run_context.json. Only its first two stages (stages_compared) have outputs here: a Modal run that matches them reproduced source construction and pre-clone enrichment byte for byte, and stages 002 onward (clone_feature_extraction through final_export, the primary PUF QRF chain included) have no local output to compare with.
